comment: The README lists the three modes as OFF, ON and OFF, which is a typing slip: the third is GEN, as the panel prints and as utils/MidiRepeater.h:52-54 declares. The switch reading is at MIDI_Repeater.cpp:119-127, with the toggle at its top giving GEN. REPEAT_SEND_INTERVAL at MidiRepeater.h:45 is RT_TASK_RATE times 0.5 task runs at 4000 runs per second, so the GEN resend is every 0.5 seconds; REPEAT_HIST_TIMEOUT at :46 is 2 seconds. Non-controller messages are returned unhandled at utils/MidiRepeater.cpp:73-75, so they never reach an output.
